title: Major-Scale Shapes, the Relative Minor & Refining “Free Fallin’”
summary: One movable major-scale shape (E at position 9, D at position 7) with the roots picked out, the relative-minor / modes idea, then “Free Fallin’” refined — open cowboy chords, and both guitar parts (capo 3 D-shapes, capo 1 E-shapes) timed to the real riff.

title: Relative Triads in D → “Free Fallin’”
summary: I–V–vi–IV triads (D–A–Bm–G) played up the neck through their inversions, then Tom Petty’s “Free Fallin’” — capo maths, the D drone, and all four guitar parts. A play button on every tab.
